about: The public trust table of the HYDRA-UMC bootloaders in source form: which public keys a bootloader accepts to sign an application image (header format 2). Only public values are written here; no secret ever is. tools/image_trust.py builds the table from this file and checks that a compiled bootloader holds exactly that table. The image-signing key is not the key that signs release assets.

dev.about: Bench builds. The seed of this key is public (image_header2.DEV_SEED): a bootloader with this table is never an official one.

release.about: Official builds. Empty until the maintainer provisions the image-signing key (procedure in tools/image_trust.py); the private half stays outside every repository. A release table with no current key cannot be built.
